notes.title: HWM 1.03 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Honorable Khans,

I am Cevozby Khan, the developer behind Oba Games, and I bring exciting news from the battlefield! Even after the full release, we're continuously improving the game based on your feedback. Here are the latest changes we've made over the past week:

Archers:
No More Unwanted Advances: Previously, our archers would inch closer to enemy forces while firing, which left them vulnerable. Now, they will remain in position while delivering their volleys, ensuring better strategic placement.

Arrow Animations: The satisfying sight of arrows soaring across the battlefield is back! Our latest improvements bring renewed charm to the archer animations. (Note: A few bugs remain, but we’re working to fix those in the near future!)

Armies:
Improved Combat Interactions: Armies would often overlap and create a chaotic visual mess during battles. We’ve worked on this issue to provide a cleaner, more stable experience, resulting in more realistic engagements.
New Attack Tactics:
Before and during battles, you can now select specific attack tactics to give your army an edge! (Reminder: Selecting a tactic increases the chance of its use, but the final choice still rests with the leader.)

Each tactic affects your army’s Health, Attack Power, Movement Speed, and Attack Speed in different ways:

These new tactics add a deeper layer of strategy to battles, giving you more control over how your armies perform. You’ll now need to plan your tactics carefully for maximum impact. A visual representation of these tactics is currently in development!

Stay Tuned for More!

As always, we are committed to delivering a better gaming experience and will continue to refine these features over time. Until then, enjoy the new updates and happy strategizing!

Cevozby Khan

Big Update
Deepening the war: We know that the wars do not fully satisfy you, the Khans, and you want to dominate the wars and make more maneuvers. For this reason, we started to work on deepening the war. We plan to add many options such as flank attacks, surrounding the army, follow, hit and run, and let you experience this in the game.
Map effect: An essential part of battlefields is, of course, the advantages and disadvantages of battlefields. Forests, puddles that must be crossed, mountains that cannot be crossed, etc. Many factors can change the course of the war. Studies on these continue.

bugfix

Units that went wrong during the battle: Sometimes when you clicked on the units more than once, they would lose their target and move to another target. We fixed this problem.

Have fun!
Cevozby

notes.title: Upcoming Update & What does the Hakan say?
notes.notes:
Hello Khans,

In the coming weeks, we're focusing on an essential piece of our game: becoming Hakan (Khan of Khans). Here's a sneak peek at what we're working on.

As you know, in our game, you play as the Khan of your clan, competing in a War League. If you win, you don't just top the league—you become the Hakan for the next season. This concept is at the heart of our game: outsmarting your rival Khans to earn the title of Hakan. However, at the moment, achieving this only gets you a congratulatory message from the mighty council and approval from your tribe's council.

What are we working on? We want to elevate this experience. As Hakan, you'll be in charge of the next season. We're planning to introduce choices that allow the Hakan to change League rules each season. Balancing these options is crucial, and it will take more work and testing. Our goal is not to make the Hakan overly powerful but to give you a sense of privilege and influence.

Stay tuned for more details on what these privileges might include as we refine the concept.

Until next time,
Oba Games

notes.title: Major Update - Steam Endless Replayability Festival
notes.notes:
Hello esteemed Khans, this is cevozby, the developer of the game.

I'm honored to announce a major update and our participation in Steam's Infinite Replayability festival. Here's what's in this update:

[h1]Contract System:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Leaders you have will now have contracts, and any leader whose contract is not renewed will be removed from your roster. 
[*] When the contract time comes, your leader's salary will be redetermined according to their current abilities.
[*] You can extend the contract of your leaders up to 5 years (the monthly salary will increase accordingly).
[*] Leaders will retire when they turn 40 years old.
[*] If your clan does not have enough budget, you may not be able to renew the leader's contract.
[*] You can automatically renew the contracts of the leaders whose contracts are about to expire with the “Auto Renew” button from the leaderboard, if it exceeds the clan's budget, the contracts of the remaining leaders from that leader will not be renewed.
[/list]

[h1]Injury System:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Your leaders are now vulnerable to injury, so you need to play carefully.
[*] If you push too hard in training, you increase the risk of your leader getting injured.
[*] A leader who both drills and fights is more likely to get injured.
[*] Depending on age and characteristics, the chance of injury may vary.
[*] If you play a slightly injured leader in a match, the chance of injury increases.
[/list]

[h1]Training System:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The training now gives you 3 options, Low/Normal/High, which you can choose to influence the development of the leaders.
[/list]

[h1]Popup System:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Since some of the features are not clear what they do, we have introduced a popup system, now you will be able to find out what the features do. 
[/list]

[h1]Battle Arena:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Our battle arena has changed, now we have an arena more worthy of your khan's army. We will continue to improve this arena.
[/list]

[h1]Error Solution:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new leader could be hired even though his clan's budget was not enough, this bug has been fixed.
[*] Pressing the spacebar would trigger the “Continue” button, but sometimes it would cause an error.
[*] Leaders were not aging as the year progressed.
[*] Text was distorted when selecting formations on the Tactics screen.
[*] Text was not appearing on the General panel in the description section of the drill maneuver.
[*] Fixed an error in music settings for the game.
[*] Language option was not staying selected.
[*] Fixed the problem of getting a leader twice when we say get a leader in the Scout section
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, mighty Khans! It's Omer here. I’ve taken over our weekly update because my brother is super busy with a big new update for our game.

Here’s the news! You know we talked about a new “contract system” last week? It’s ready now, but it’s got lots of bugs. We’ve fixed most of them, but we still need to test them more.

Now, let’s talk about some cool new stuff we’re adding to the game.

[h2]Training System Tweak:[/h2]
We're making some tweaks to the training system to give you more control over the development of your leaders. You'll be able to set your leaders' training speed to low, normal, or high. But watch out—ramping up the pace comes with its own set of risks, which I'll get into in a sec.

[h1]Injury Mechanic:[/h1]
What's the fun in using the same leader week after week without consequences? In our next update, leaders can get injured. If they get really hurt, they can’t train or play in matches. 

[i]So, think carefully before you keep playing your star leader match after match.[/i]

[h2]How to Avoid Injuries:[/h2]
Just like in real life, there are various factors that can lead to injuries in our game:
[list]
[*] Training: Pushing your leaders too hard in training can lead to amazing improvements or... painful injuries.
[*] Battling: Sure, it's tempting to use your top leader in every fight, but battles come with injury risks, especially if your leader loses.
[*] Aging: Just like in real life, getting older means even everyday activities can lead to injuries. (I feel this one personally!)
[*] Physical Stats: Not all leaders are created equal. Some are just tough as nails and can take a beating. If your leader's physical stats aren't up to snuff, consider focusing their training on physical stats.
[*] Existing Injuries: There's a bit of irony here, but sometimes you roll the dice and play a leader who's not fully healed. They might turn the tide or end up sidelining themselves for good.
[/list]

With these updates, we're adding a new layer of strategy to Hakan's War Manager. Plus, we're polishing up some quality-of-life improvements too. Stay tuned!

Until next time, 
Oba Games

notes.title: Localization System - Part 3 - Localization Update
notes.notes:
[b]Attention:[/b] After the update, you may need to start a new save for a seamless experience.

We came to the most challenging part of localization. Translating messages. 

It works the same as dynamic texts, messages are also dynamic. For example, in a battle result message, there are values that can change according to the battle, and translation can be done by assigning arguments accordingly. So far, it works like the system I have done with dynamic texts. After that, the troublesome process started, the save&load system...

[h2][b]Before the localization system[/b], [/h2]
I was saving the messages as follows:
[list]
[*] I created a script called MessageData
[*] Take the string value in the header and save it
[*] Get and save the string value in the content section
[/list]
This way I save each message in MessageData and then pull it from this folder when I want to upload it.

[h2][b]But how can I save in a constant way for values that can change continuously? [/b][/h2]
I did some research on this, but unfortunately, I couldn't find anything useful in most of them. Mostly everyone discussed about constant and dynamic text, but not much about saving with JSON. So I opened the topic myself and someone from Unity wrote me a reply. With a little help from him and some tinkering on my own, I came to a conclusion.

[h2]So what did I do?[/h2]
I saved each of our message drafts to the localization system, then in the MessageData section I kept the key and argument for the header, key and argument for the content, and set the argument to string[] so that it doesn't have problems when saving. 

Apart from messages, I also needed localization for the calendar system, but I was able to easily handle this by using Unity's own Calendar system.

[h2][b]Localization Finished[/b][/h2]

We've come to the end of this system, I've been working on the localization system lately and it's finally time to announce it. The localization system is finished and now we will open the localization system to you players with an update.

Apart from that, the date error in the battle results section of the Inbox system has been fixed.

Note: At the moment our game only supports English and Turkish languages, we will start working on Italian and Chinese. If you want to support us in any language, you can contact us. (We do not want to offer basic Google translation.)

notes.title: HWM Early Access Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mighty Khans!

I'm Omer, the game designer at Oba Games, and I want to share our Early Access roadmap with you. First off, a big thank you to everyone who played, wishlisted, or bought the game during the launch weekend. Your support means a lot.

Now, let's talk about the Early Access phase. We want to avoid a prolonged Early Access period, but we also want to keep the game alive and thriving post-release. Keeping things simple is a challenge for us because this is our first project, and we're deeply passionate about the game's concept. To give you a clearer picture of our vision, I'd like to share our roadmap for the upcoming updates. We've identified three major areas for improvement, based on both our own goals and feedback from the community.

[h1][h2]Roadmap Overview[/h2][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44297973/98bbb0d349bdd7f1ca8df2c919704fa292075d0a.png[/img]

[h2]1. Translation/Localization[/h2]
[b]Objective[/b]: Making the game accessible to a wider audience by translating it into multiple languages.
[b]Process:[/b] We're figuring out the localization process, and once sorted, we'll use Google Translate for languages other than our first (Turkish). Volunteers are welcome to join our Discord for assistance.

[h2]2. Battle UI Improvement[/h2]
[b]Objective: [/b]Enhancing the battle UI to maintain clarity and prevent visual chaos, especially during large-scale battles.
[b]Approach: [/b]Taking inspiration from games like Medieval Total War, we aim to implement pop-ups showing unit details and vital information. Background and unit improvements are also on the agenda for a more appealing and understandable experience.

[h2]3. Hakan League Mechanic[/h2]
[b]Objective: [/b]Introducing a unique league mechanic where the winning tactician becomes the "Khan" and the overall winner earns the title of "Hakan," the king of kings.
[b]Vision: [/b]The Hakan, as the ruler, will have the opportunity to influence league rules for the next season, adding a dynamic and strategic element to the gameplay.

Your feedback, suggestions, and discussions are invaluable to us. Feel free to share your thoughts on these upcoming features and help us shape the future of "Hakan's War Manager."

Best regards,
Oba Games

notes.notes:
Greetings, Esteemed Khans!

Omer here from Oba Games, bringing you the latest updates on what's been happening in the last week:

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Dark UI[/h3]
After considering your feedback and engaging in discussions and brainstorming sessions, we've delved into the realm of Dark UI. Our current plan is to maintain both UI options, giving players the choice.
Originally, our goal with the original UI was to create a Turkic oriental vibe. With the new Dark UI, we're aiming for a cleaner, text-based, and less eye-straining interface. 
Here's a sneak peek at the early prototype of the Dark UI:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44297973/61b12f5e50658aedd71d2a0e32c4aebfebf48476.png[/img]

[h3]Troops and In-Battle Adjustments[/h3]
We're introducing a new element called "discipline" to the game. While not entirely novel, it's a fresh addition for us. In battles, we want to give leader stats more purpose. For instance, good leaders with high stats will be able to arrange their troops more tidily, whereas bad leaders will struggle to manage their armies efficiently. 
Here's an example of what we're working on: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44297973/d0bee8acb7d120dc0c588386b5d6113483daa826.png[/img]

We're also working on adjusting the numbers and troop locations to make battles feel more dynamic. Our goal is to create a battlefield where the separation between right and left wings has a significant impact. In the new system, winning a battle on a wing will have a more pronounced effect compared to the old system where all the lines were close together.

Additionally, we're introducing the concept of back lines to make timing more critical. The decisions of when to attack or support the front line can now greatly influence the outcome of the battle. Perhaps you want your back lines to maneuver through the wings and forget about the center. It's all about strategic choices that add depth to the gameplay.

We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback as we strive to make "Hakan's War Manager" an even more immersive experience. Feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions!

Best regards,
Oba Games

[h3]Greetings, Valiant Khans,[/h3]

We are thrilled to announce that the day has arrived – the release of [b]the demo[/b] is upon us! We're excited to share a taste of our game with you. In this demo, you'll have the opportunity to step into the shoes of a Khan and be a manager of your clan. 

[h2][b]Key Features of the Demo:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Lead your clan in a sports competition. Make friendly battles with other clans.
[*] Make decisions about scouting, squad management, and training systems.
[*] Set your tactics and orders for unit actions for the battle.
[*] Witness the development of leaders who will fight for your clan in real-time battles.
[/list]

[h3]Download the Demo:[/h3]
You can download the demo here and immerse yourself in the world of "Hakan's War Manager."

[h3]Provide Feedback:[/h3]
As you play the demo, we encourage you to share your thoughts and feedback. Your insights will play a crucial role in shaping the future of the game. Feel free to use the "Contact Us" section within the game to provide your valuable feedback.

Warm regards,
[i][b]Oba Games[/b][/i]
